news.text: 😬 "There is talk of a possible link between Weston #Mckennie and #ManchesterUnited.Any player who performs well with the United States National Team will be associated almost immediately with #United, due to the arrival of Mauricio #Pochettino, who used to coach the national team.Today, in a press conference, #McKennie said that there are many strong players there, that it is logical for those associations with #United to arise and that you never really know what managers want to do.#McKennie is one of the most adaptable and versatile players in the world.With #Juventus, he has played in midfield, as a full-back, he can play as a defender, an attacking midfielder and a false nine. #United's

👀 "Rumors are circulating about #Chelsea's #Alajbegović.For #Juventus, #Alajbegović was a major signing, for the present and the future.#Juve is completely counting on him and today he is a fundamental player.The links with #Chelsea are natural, because this club pursued him in the past.In the summer, #Chelsea viewed him as a "project player": sign him, send him out on loan, help him develop and not give him an important role right now."[@FabrizioRomano on YouTube via @PuebloJ]

#Napoli is ahead in the race for #Varela. #Juventus has also entered the picture for January for the Portuguese goalscorer, who has been the star of an extraordinary start to the season with 9 goals and 1 assist. A great piece of scouting by #Monza.#Benfica holds 20% on the capital gain of a future sale and the option to match any highest offer. It is not a buyback clause because the player will decide. Valuation? Around 30 million euros.[Daniele Longo]
